snippet.title: Love is Undead - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/185326/love-is-undead/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4535780/Love_is_Undead/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!
